main.description: One dated count taken on a community activity: signatures collected so far, people at a march, tickets sold. Each record is a single observation with how it was counted; a series of them is the activity's history. Written into the measurer's own repo. Measurements by the community's current organizers are the official series; ones by its other active members are served separately as independent counts, and anyone else's are not served. Append-only: the first indexed version is the one served, and a later edit only marks it as edited.

metric.description: What was counted. Money is not measured here: income, expenses and donations are com.para.community.activityLedgerEntry records.

value.description: The count. For cumulative metrics this is the running total at measuredAt, not the increase since the last measurement.

valueLow.description: Lower bound when the count is an estimate, e.g. crowd size.

valueHigh.description: Upper bound when the count is an estimate.

cumulative.description: True when value is a running total (signatures so far); false or absent for a point-in-time count (people present at 17:00).

methodNote.description: Detail on the method, e.g. who counted and where.

evidenceUris.description: A photo, a scanned tally sheet, an authority's certification.

measuredAt.description: When the count was taken, not when it was written.
